capabilities: Render a monthly calendar for each named habit with custom colors
Cycle date marks between unmarked, green and pink by clicking or tapping
Edit a habit list with Y/N visibility, named or hex colors and swatches
Freeze previous months read-only with saved statistics and calendar snapshots
Navigate months with previous/next controls and a month picker
extras: Not yet in the community directory: install requires downloading main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from GitHub Releases and copying them manually; upgrading from the old plugin ID needs a migration guide to preserve data.json and Habit Tracker records. Changing the habit list with 'Yes' clears all current-month marks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track daily habits on per-habit monthly calendars with manual completion marks and retained month-by-month history.

relations.evidence: Do not run old Habit Calendar 001 with the same records.

summary: Habit tracker that renders a monthly calendar per habit, marks days by tap-cycling green/pink, and keeps past months read-only with frozen statistics.
